trajectories.title: Diagnose a Python process leaking memory
trajectories.summary: A long batch job leaked RSS until the worker OOM-killed. The session used tracemalloc, objgraph, and gc.get_objects to find a cache that never evicted.

trajectories.title: Add Windows steps to a memory-debug skill
trajectories.summary: The Linux-only skill missed VMMap and Performance Monitor. The rewrite added Windows Developer Mode notes and junction vs symlink install failures.

trajectories.title: Roll forward a failed Alembic migration
trajectories.summary: A production Alembic revision left the database half-migrated. The session inspected alembic_version, wrote a data-backfill step, and documented a down revision.

trajectories.title: Unstick docker compose networking
trajectories.summary: A compose stack could not reach the database because the app service joined the wrong network and the healthcheck used localhost instead of the service name.

trajectories.title: Retry 401s without hammering the token endpoint
trajectories.summary: An HTTP client refreshed tokens on every 401 and hit the IdP rate limit. The fix used a single-flight lock, jittered backoff, and a cached token expiry.

trajectories.title: Import a local skill folder into the team repo
trajectories.summary: The user had a hand-written SKILL.md and wanted it on main, not SkillHub. xskill import copied the folder, pinned it for the initiator, and kept the staging branch.

trajectories.title: Memory leak hunt stopped after the process died
trajectories.summary: tracemalloc was attached too late; the worker was already OOM-killed. The session never captured a snapshot and the user abandoned the debug.
